_comment: The creatures roster (docs/plan_predators.md). Intrinsic CombatStats for non-fauna units. A human is not wildlife (not fauna_config) and its stats are not resolver tuning (not combat_config). Playtest dials.
_comment_durability: DURABILITY is how much damage a body soaks before it goes down (docs/plan_hunt_through_combat.md 4.2) - authored, never derived from mass. A person is on the BOAR/WOLF tier (20): a body with neither bulk nor armour, which takes a few solid hits and no more. It is what turns an animal's ferocity-scaled attack into casualties, so it is the single dial that says how costly a dangerous hunt and a predator raid are.
